## Methane Map 

unit for methane: milligrams of carbon per square meter per day $mg C m^2/day$

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
setwd("/Users/rachelhopp/Desktop/R Folder Stats/Final")
sites <- read_csv("GRiMe_sites_v2.csv")
flux  <- read_csv("CH4Flux.csv")

ch4_site_mean <- flux %>%
  group_by(Site_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Site_Name = first(Site_Name),
    Source_ID = paste(unique(Source_ID), collapse = ";"),
    n_flux = sum(!is.na(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean)),
    Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean = if (n_flux > 0) mean(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sites %>% select(Site_ID, Latitude, Longitude), by = "Site_ID") %>%
  filter(between(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, 0, 100)) %>%  # drops NA and zero/negative site means
  select(Latitude, Longitude, Site_ID, Site_Name, Source_ID,
         Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, n_flux)

write_csv(ch4_site_mean, "CH4Flux_site_means.csv")
flux <- read.csv("CH4Flux_site_means.csv")
max(flux$Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
median(flux$Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
min(flux$Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}


# ---- Runs ONCE, when the app starts ----------------------------------------
flux = read.csv(
  "/Users/rachelhopp/Desktop/R Folder Stats/Final/CH4Flux_site_means.csv"
) |>
  select(Site_ID, Site_Name, Latitude, Longitude, Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, n_flux)

# Literature sites with 13C-depleted benthic/hyporheic insects
depleted = read.csv(
  "/Users/rachelhopp/Desktop/R Folder Stats/Final/Depletedsites.csv",
  check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)
names(depleted) = trimws(names(depleted))   # "Latitude " / "Longitude " have trailing spaces
depleted = depleted |>
  transmute(Site = `Site Location`, Latitude, Longitude)

# Fixed color scale so the legend doesn't change when the filter moves
pal = colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = flux$Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean)

ui = page_sidebar(
  title = "Diffusive Methane Flux, Freshwater",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    sliderInput(
      "min_flux", "Minimum flux (mmol m-2 d-1)",
      min = 0, max = ceiling(max(flux$Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean)),
      value = 0, step = 1
    ),
    textOutput("n")
  ),
  leafletOutput("map")
)

server = function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Re-runs whenever the slider changes
  flux_sub = reactive({
    flux |> filter(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean >= input$min_flux)
  })
  
  output$n = renderText({
    paste(nrow(flux_sub()), "sites shown")
  })
  
  add_sites = function(map, data) {
    map |>
      clearGroup("flux") |>                     # only clears the flux dots, not the star symbols
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = data, lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude, group = "flux",
        radius = ~pmax(3, sqrt(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean) * 1.5),
        weight = 1, color = "black",
        fillColor = ~pal(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean), fillOpacity = 0.7,
        popup = ~paste0("<b>", Site_Name, "</b> (Site ", Site_ID, ")<br>",
                        "Mean flux: ", round(Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean, 2),
                        " mmol m-2 d-1<br>n = ", n_flux)
      )
  }
  
  # Base map, legend, depleted-site symbols, first set of dots (runs once)
  output$map = renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() |>
      addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
      setView(lng = 0, lat = 20, zoom = 2) |>
      addLegend(
        position = "bottomleft", pal = pal,
        values = flux$Diffusive_CH4_Flux_Mean,
        title = "Flux (mmol m-2 d-1)", opacity = 0.8
      ) |>
      addAwesomeMarkers(
        data = depleted, lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude,
        icon = awesomeIcons(icon = "star", library = "fa",
                            markerColor = "blue", iconColor = "white"),
        label = ~Site,     # shows on hover
        popup = ~Site      # shows on click
      ) |>
      add_sites(isolate(flux_sub()))
  })
  
  # Swap the flux dots only when the slider moves
  observe({
    leafletProxy("map") |>
      add_sites(flux_sub())
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
